title: Alexander
desc: CBI officer Alexander investigates a complex case involving murder, smuggling and political corruption. However, his search leads him to a dangerous game of cat and mouse with powerful adversaries.

title: Seetha
desc: Seetha, a nurse, falls in love with Ramu, a young man, and gets married. She, however, realises that her life did not turn out the way she expected it to.

title: Thangappathakkam
desc: SP Choudhury, a police officer, and his rebelious son's relationship becomes strained after the son gets arrested for illegal activities.

title: Yamirukka Bayamen
desc: Karpagam believes in Lord Murugan whereas Viji, an atheist, mocks her beliefs. She challenges that after a year her life will be better than Karpagam's. Their situations change when they meet again.

title: Mettukudi
desc: A man pretends to be the son of a long-lost royal family to steal a precious sword. However, his plan runs into complications when the granddaughter of the sword's guardian falls in love with him.
